name: tutorial-video-director
description: Tutorial series video director: episode planning, beats and narration, SVG lecture cards exported to PPTX, browser operation recording, edge-tts dubbing, subtitles and final cut rendering.

displayDescription.en: Turns a topic into a tutorial video series: episode outline, beats and narration, SVG lecture cards and PPTX, real operation recording, edge-tts dubbing, subtitles and the final cut.
displayDescription.zh: 把主题拆成系列教程：分集大纲、分镜台词、SVG讲义卡与PPT、录屏配音加字幕，直出成片。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要做一套关于 [主题] 的系列教程视频，先帮我出分集大纲和第一集分镜
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want a tutorial video series about [topic]. Start with the episode outline and the first episode's beats.

quickPrompts.en: I want a tutorial video series about [topic]. Start with the episode outline and the first episode's beats.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要做一套关于 [主题] 的系列教程视频，先帮我出分集大纲和第一集分镜

quickPrompts.en: Turn this episode's narration into SVG lecture cards and export a PPTX deck.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这集的讲稿做成 SVG 讲义卡，再导出一份 PPT

quickPrompts.en: Record this browser operation, dub it with edge-tts, add subtitles and cut it into the final video.
quickPrompts.zh: 录一段这个浏览器操作，配 edge-tts 配音和字幕，剪成成片
